section.p: Consider a bulleted list with a second tier of bullet items beneath selected parent items, using the Increase Indent button in the Home ribbon.

section.p: Result:Nested bullets are preserved when Word list levels are applied correctly.
section.note: Never simulate indentation using spaces or TAB characters in a Normal paragraph — this does not create a nested list structure, and the converter does not recognise it as such.
